status: complete; blind evaluation and assistant adjudication finished
method: Non-blind parent audit of original videos via timestamped extracted frames: 2fps for 13 shorts, 0.25fps overview for long clip, selected full-resolution frames and dense follow-ups. No native motion playback or independent audio perception. This is an evidence review, not proof that no other defects exist.

coverage.assessment: Counter/body geometry, character placement, duplicate waitress, props, lighting and meal chronology are already represented. Overview sampled every 4 seconds; selected original-resolution frames checked. Brief events between samples are not exhaustively audited.
Red-ball duplication and changing ball geometry are covered by MARB-1. No separate additional defect established.
Pose mismatch, tattoo changes, hand in front/behind, and extra reflected door are already in the current truth.
No additional visual defect established. The audio claim is in the structured truth; audio was not independently heard in this audit.
Kitchen connectivity and chairs at the foot of the bed are already covered. Do not count the microwave in the second kitchen as a separate defect.
Count/state changes, double tie and extra-finger annotation are already covered. Deliberate sleight of hand must not itself count as a defect.
Reflected action mismatch and changing grooming implement are already covered.
Garbled UI and lack of response already belong to PHON-1. No additional defect established.
Source-vessel and transfer defects are covered. The receiving jar’s side protrusion is visible at the start and end; rejected as a new hardware-appearance claim.
Malformed underside/wheel arrangement is visible in the 2.0s frame and is already SKAT-1. Foot-state problems are already SKAT-2.
The later winding motion is already within WATC-1. The tweezers move down out of frame around 4s; that is insufficient evidence of disappearance.
Multiplication and color changes are already BLOC-1. A 3→6 face change near 7.75s occurs during a turn; without resolving face rotation, it is not a defensible extra text defect.
Apple support/disappearance, unnatural fruit colors and background glyphs are already covered. Do not reintroduce the previously rejected umbrella claim.
Body/hood geometry, plate, road, airflow and wiper annotations already exist. No separate additional defect established.

blind_protocol: One independent core evaluation per video × six roles; separate feature inventory; deterministic router; three independent evaluations per triggered check; union score; no global confounds or verification pass.
blind_limitations: GPT-6 Astra high reasoning, default service tier, Codex harness.
Actual input is timestamped image frames with optional denser inspection, not native video.
Audio currently unassessed, not evidence of silence.
Fresh task contexts and restricted-path instructions; shared filesystem is not an OS-enforced blind sandbox.
Existing v2 prompts were developed from this benchmark and include dataset-informed examples. Blind access to labels is not equivalent to an unseen holdout benchmark.
Three router samples are not three independent complete benchmark replications.
